course_points.n: At roundabout, take exit 2 onto Haßfurter Straße
Turn right onto Sander Straße and drive toward Sand
Keep right onto HAS 14 and drive toward Schweinfurt, Haßfurt
Turn right onto In der Au
Turn left onto Hauptstraße and drive toward Eltmann, Limbach
At roundabout, take exit 1 onto St 2262
Turn slight left onto Am Leinritt
Turn right onto Michelsberger Straße and drive toward am Michelsberg
Turn left onto Margaretendamm and drive toward Hafen
